40 Which list of particles contains only fundamental particles?
A
antineutrino, beta, meson
B
baryon, neutrino, positron
C
electron, neutrino, alpha
D
lepton, quark, positron

hints: Notice the word only - you must check all three names in each list, and one composite particle disqualifies the whole list.
Recall the test for fundamental: quarks and leptons have no internal structure, while hadrons such as mesons and baryons and nuclei such as alpha particles are made of smaller particles.

Sort the names given: meson is quark-antiquark, baryon is three quarks, alpha is two protons plus two neutrons, while electron, neutrino, antineutrino, positron, lepton and quark belong to the fundamental groups.
walkthrough: Identify what fundamental means in particle physics: a particle with no internal structure made of other particles. In this syllabus the fundamental matter particles are quarks and leptons (and their antiparticles).
Recall the composites: hadrons are made of quarks - mesons are $q\bar{q}$ and baryons are $qqq$. Nuclei such as the alpha particle are made of protons and neutrons, which are themselves baryons.
Check each composite name: meson in list A is not fundamental, baryon in list B is not fundamental, alpha particle in list C is a $2p+2n$ nucleus and is not fundamental.
Check the remaining names: antineutrino, beta-particle which is an electron, electron, neutrino and positron are all leptons or antileptons and are fundamental.

List D contains lepton as the family name for fundamental leptons, quark as the family name for fundamental quarks, and positron as a specific antilepton. All three are fundamental with no smaller constituents.
Therefore only one list has three fundamental entries throughout. This is option D

A.explanation: Antineutrino and beta-particle (electron) are fundamental leptons, but meson is a hadron made of a quark and an antiquark so it is not fundamental.

B.explanation: Neutrino and positron are fundamental leptons, but baryon is a hadron made of three quarks so it is not fundamental.

C.explanation: Electron and neutrino are fundamental leptons, but alpha particle is a helium-4 nucleus of two protons and two neutrons so it is not fundamental.

D.explanation: Quarks and leptons are the fundamental matter families, and positron is an antilepton, so all three entries are fundamental with no quark substructure to break down.
